title: Ovid2 data-health check spec
description: One declarative data-health check. Ported from the PCORnet EDC / Data Curation Query (DCQ) package plus Ovid2-native health panels. A registry of these specs drives the `ovid2 health` runner; each spec names an operator from `ovid2.transformations.quality.ops` and its parameters.

id.description: Stable check identifier. For EDC checks this is the DC row number (e.g. '1.01'); for native panels a dotted slug (e.g. 'health.null_rate').

part.description: Grouping bucket for the run window / report nav tree.

edc_table.description: EDC report table this check populates (e.g. 'Table IID'). Informational; blank for native panels.

description.description: One-line human description of what the check validates.

operator.description: Name of the check operator in `ovid2.transformations.quality.ops`.

source_tables.description: CDM tables the check reads. Used to auto-skip checks whose tables are absent.

na_when_empty.description: CDM tables whose *collective* emptiness downgrades the check to `not_applicable` (SAS empty-table rule, edc_report.sas:11314-11354). The check is n/a only when EVERY listed table is absent or has zero rows; if any is populated the check runs normally. Mirrors e.g. DC_3_08 -> n/a when PRESCRIBING is empty.

params.description: Operator-specific parameters. Shape validated by the operator itself at run time.

metrics.description: Metric names this check emits into the result rows.

exception_metrics.description: Subset of `metrics` whose exceedance flags an EXCEPTION.

thresholds.description: Threshold config consumed by the operator to set EXCEPTION_FLAG.

enabled.description: When false, the check is skipped even if requested.
